candidates.title: Great Victoria Street Station closed to rail passengers
candidates.summary: Translink's Belfast Grand Central Station enabling-work page records Great Victoria Street Station's permanent closure at the end of Friday 10 May 2024 and states that the rail line would remain open through Belfast but no longer serve that station.
candidates.observed_change: The former Great Victoria Street rail station stopped being served by rail passengers; Translink listed alternative stations and ticket-validity arrangements for the transition period.

candidates.observed_change: The existing rail station was recorded under the Lanyon Place name, with station-front and ticket-office changes documented in the same source passage.
